name: rrr-benchmark
description:
RRR Benchmark Datasets
	

Russian Router Ranking (RRR) benchmark datasets for testing dialogue routing models.

	
		
		Dataset Splits
	

This dataset contains 11 splits organized by complexity level:

	
		
		generic (130 items)
	

Original processed dataset from dataset_input.json with variable routes per item

	
		
		routes_2 (1000 items)
	

Synthetic dataset with exactly 2 route options per item

	
		
		routes_3 (1000 items)
	

Synthetic dataset with exactly 3 route options per item… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/evilfreelancer/rrr-benchmark.
reputation: A niche benchmark focused on dialogue routing; used by a small community researching dialogue-management and routing strategies.
